sn16.4:1.3: kathaṃrūpo bhikkhu arahati kulūpako hotuṃ kathaṃrūpo bhikkhu na arahati kulūpako hotunti.
sn16.4:2.1: yo hi koci bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ citto kulāni upasaṅkamati
sn16.4:2.3: bahu kaññeva me dentu mā thokaṃ
sn16.4:2.7: tassa ce bhikkhave bhikkhuno evaṃcittassa kulāni upasaṅkamato na denti tena bhikkhu sandiyati so tatonidānaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedayati.
sn16.4:2.10: dandhaṃ denti no sīghaṃ tena bhikkhu sandiyati so tatonidānaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedayati.
sn16.4:2.11: asakkaccaṃ denti no sakkaccaṃ tena bhikkhu sandiyati so tatonidānaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedayati.
sn16.4:2.12: evarūpo kho bhikkhave bhikkhu na arahati kulūpako hotuṃ.
sn16.4:3.1: yo ca kho bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃcitto kulāni upa saṅkamati
sn16.4:3.8: tassa ce bhikkhave bhikkhuno evaṃcittassa kulāni upasaṅkamato na denti tena bhikkhu na sandiyati so na tatonidānaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedayati.
sn16.4:3.9: thokaṃ denti no bahukaṃ tena bhikkhu na sandīyati so na tatonidānaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭi saṃvedayati.
sn16.4:3.11: dandhaṃ denti no sīghaṃ tena bhikkhu na sandiyati so na tatonidānaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedayati.
sn16.4:3.12: asakkaccaṃ denti no sakkaccaṃ tena bhikkhu na sandiyati so na tatonidānaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedayati.
sn16.4:3.13: evarūpo kho bhikkhave bhikkhu arahati kulūpako hotuṃ.
sn16.4:4.8: na denti tena kassapo na sandīyati so na tatonidānaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedayati.
sn16.4:4.9: thokaṃ denti no bahukaṃ tena kassapo na sandiyati so na tatonidānaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedayati.
sn16.4:4.10: lūkhaṃ denti no paṇītaṃ tena kassapo na sandiyati so na tatonidānaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭi saṃvedayati.
sn16.4:4.11: dandhaṃ denti no sīghaṃ tena kassapo na sandiyati so na tatonidānaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedayati.
sn16.4:4.12: asakkaccaṃ denti no sakkaccaṃ tena kassapo na sandiyati so na tatonidānaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedayati.
sn16.4:4.13: kassapena vā hi vo bhikkhave ovadissāmi yo vā panassa kassapādiso ovaditehi ca pana vo tathattāya paṭipajjitabbanti.
